articles.title: China's Wang urges Middle East dialogue in meetings with Iranian, Saudi officials
articles.description: BEIJING, Nov 2 (Reuters) - Chinese Foreign Minister WangYi, in separate meetings with Iranian and Saudi national security officials in Beijing on Monday, said all parties in the Middle East conflict should focus on political solutions rather than resorting to arms again.China, which is pressing for a bigger diplomatic role in the Middle East, also announced thatits special envoy would visit Iran, Oman and Saudi Arabia this month.

articles.title: China to Send Special Envoy to Middle East in November to Promote Peace
articles.description: Zhai Jun, the Chinese government's special envoy for the Middle East, will visit Iran, Oman and Saudi Arabia in the first half of November to promote peace and security in the region, Chinese Foreign Ministry spokeswoman Mao Ning said on Monday.

articles.title: Iran has a 2-day plan to reopen Strait, resume nuclear talks with US, and other Mideast news
articles.description: Iran said it had a two-day plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and resume nuclear talks with the United States, if Washington meets its demands. Separately, the U.N. migration agency said more than 300,000 people in Yemen have fled renewed fighting. China is sending a special envoy to Iran, Saudi Arabia and Oman. articles.title: China's Xi says Middle East should not become battleground for great power rivalry
articles.description: BEIJING/DUBAI, Nov 2 (Reuters) - The Middle East and Gulf region should not become a battleground for great-power rivalry and China is willing to work with Arab nations to achieve lasting peace, Chinese President Xi Jinping told Oman's sultan on Monday.China has traditionally played a low-key diplomatic role in the Middle East, but has stepped up efforts to try to help end tensions amid the US-Israeli war on Iran,which has snarled the Strait of Hormuz and driven up global energy and shipping costs.
